newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Friday conducted a round of purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent in the money market, traders said.
The central bank intervened to add liquidity to the market after the call loan rate traded near the top of the Bank of Canada's 3.75-4.25 percent target range.
"There's nothing unusual about it. Overnight financing was trading at the upper end of the band and at 4.25 the Bank chose to come in and do specials," said one Toronto-based dealer.
After the intervention the call loan or overnight lending rate continued to trade at 4.25 percent.
